description: For an http or api monitor on Pro and Business plans: the website's registered domain, its subdomains from certificate transparency logs (crt.sh, which can be days or weeks behind) with where each points and any CNAME to a service that reports no site there (subdomain_alerts), and the registered typo and look-alike spellings of the domain with their addresses, mail servers and registration dates (lookalike_alerts). Free.
name: get_domain_watch
title: Subdomains and lookalikes of a website's domain
